integrity: Standalone proof and standard-library verification; finite direct-composition checks n=4..10 and exact finite matching counts n=4..8. Numerical tests are not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to rank n-1 with n>=4 and involution matchings fixing all idempotents. Arbitrary involutive/permutation matchings and other rank strata are not classified. No independent audit or historical-priority certification.
title: Rigidity of idempotent-fixing inverse matchings in the top singular rank of an isotone monoid
